7-7 7\"></path></svg></button></div></form></div></div></section></div></div></div></div><div class=\"bg-[#D1B79C]/50 py-12\"><div class=\"container mx-auto px-4\"><div class=\"grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-4 items-start\"><div style=\"opacity: 0; transform: none;\"><div class=\"mx-auto max-w-3xl p-4 mb-10\"><h3 class=\"mb-6 text-2xl font-bold\">For you who move where the work is</h3><div class=\"border-b border-black divide-y divide-black divide-white border-white\"><div class=\"py-2\"><h2><button id=\"faqs-text-0\" type=\"button\" class=\"flex w-full items-start text-left font-semibold py-2\" aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"faqs-text-0\"><svg class=\"fill-black shrink-0 mr-4 mt-1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\"><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center rotate-90 transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect></svg><span>Where can I stay in Sweden for a work assignment lasting weeks or months?</span></button></h2><div id=\"faqs-text-0\" role=\"region\" aria-labelledby=\"faqs-text-0\" class=\"grid text-sm ml-8 text-black overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0\"><div class=\"overflow-hidden\"><p class=\"pb-3\">For anything beyond a few days, a serviced apartment is the most practical option. You get a proper apartment with a kitchen, living space, WiFi, and laundry access, which makes an enormous difference when you're staying for weeks rather than just passing through a city. Företagsbostäder is Sweden's largest provider of serviced apartments, with locations in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Malmö, Helsingborg, Lund, and several other cities. Your company handles the booking and billing. You just show up and move in.</p></div></div></div><div class=\"py-2\"><h2><button id=\"faqs-text-1\" type=\"button\" class=\"flex w-full items-start text-left font-semibold py-2\" aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"faqs-text-1\"><svg class=\"fill-black shrink-0 mr-4 mt-1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\"><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center rotate-90 transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect></svg><span>Is a serviced apartment cheaper than staying in a hotel for a long project?</span></button></h2><div id=\"faqs-text-1\" role=\"region\" aria-labelledby=\"faqs-text-1\" class=\"grid text-sm ml-8 text-black overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0\"><div class=\"overflow-hidden\"><p class=\"pb-3\">Usually by a wide margin, yes. A serviced apartment gives you more space, a proper kitchen (which alone can save a fortune on food), and a daily rate that drops significantly with longer stays. For a monthly booking, the difference compared to even a mid-range hotel is hard to ignore. That's the main reason most companies have switched from hotels to serviced apartments for extended assignments.</p></div></div></div><div class=\"py-2\"><h2><button id=\"faqs-text-2\" type=\"button\" class=\"flex w-full items-start text-left font-semibold py-2\" aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"faqs-text-2\"><svg class=\"fill-black shrink-0 mr-4 mt-1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\"><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center rotate-90 transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect></svg><span>What's included in a serviced apartment, so I know what to pack?</span></button></h2><div id=\"faqs-text-2\" role=\"region\" aria-labelledby=\"faqs-text-2\" class=\"grid text-sm ml-8 text-black overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0\"><div class=\"overflow-hidden\"><p class=\"pb-3\">Short answer: pack like you're visiting a friend who has a fully stocked home. Every serviced apartment comes with a kitchen that has everything from a coffee maker and microwave to proper cookware and plates, plus bed linen, towels, high-speed WiFi, TV, and an iron. The rent also covers electricity and heating. Many apartments have their own washing machine; others share laundry facilities in the building. You really only need to bring your clothes and personal things.</p></div></div></div><div class=\"py-2\"><h2><button id=\"faqs-text-3\" type=\"button\" class=\"flex w-full items-start text-left font-semibold py-2\" aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"faqs-text-3\"><svg class=\"fill-black shrink-0 mr-4 mt-1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\"><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center rotate-90 transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect></svg><span>Can I cook my own meals and do laundry in the apartment?</span></button></h2><div id=\"faqs-text-3\" role=\"region\" aria-labelledby=\"faqs-text-3\" class=\"grid text-sm ml-8 text-black overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0\"><div class=\"overflow-hidden\"><p class=\"pb-3\">Yes to both. The kitchen is fully equipped for everyday cooking. On the laundry side, some serviced apartments have a machine in the unit, and the rest have access to a shared laundry room with booking instructions in Swedish and English.</p></div></div></div><div class=\"py-2\"><h2><button id=\"faqs-text-4\" type=\"button\" class=\"flex w-full items-start text-left font-semibold py-2\" aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"faqs-text-4\"><svg class=\"fill-black shrink-0 mr-4 mt-1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\"><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center rotate-90 transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect></svg><span>Can I have friends, family, or colleagues over to my apartment?</span></button></h2><div id=\"faqs-text-4\" role=\"region\" aria-labelledby=\"faqs-text-4\" class=\"grid text-sm ml-8 text-black overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0\"><div class=\"overflow-hidden\"><p class=\"pb-3\">Of course. That's one of the real advantages a serviced apartment has over a hotel room. Have colleagues over for dinner, let your family visit for the weekend, use the living room for an informal meeting. It's your home for the time you're there.</p></div></div></div><div class=\"py-2\"><h2><button id=\"faqs-text-5\" type=\"button\" class=\"flex w-full items-start text-left font-semibold py-2\" aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"faqs-text-5\"><svg class=\"fill-black shrink-0 mr-4 mt-1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\"><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center rotate-90 transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect></svg><span>What happens if something breaks or I need help outside office hours?</span></button></h2><div id=\"faqs-text-5\" role=\"region\" aria-labelledby=\"faqs-text-5\" class=\"grid text-sm ml-8 text-black overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0\"><div class=\"overflow-hidden\"><p class=\"pb-3\">You have access to 24/7 guest service, including an emergency line for urgent things. If an appliance breaks through normal use, just report it and we'll sort out a replacement. Living in a serviced apartment should feel as supported as staying in a hotel.</p></div></div></div><div class=\"py-2\"><h2><button id=\"faqs-text-6\" type=\"button\" class=\"flex w-full items-start text-left font-semibold py-2\" aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"faqs-text-6\"><svg class=\"fill-black shrink-0 mr-4 mt-1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\"><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center rotate-90 transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect></svg><span>Are the serviced apartments centrally located or close to major workplaces?</span></button></h2><div id=\"faqs-text-6\" role=\"region\" aria-labelledby=\"faqs-text-6\" class=\"grid text-sm ml-8 text-black overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0\"><div class=\"overflow-hidden\"><p class=\"pb-3\">It depends on what works best for you. We have serviced apartments in city centres with easy access to public transport, and we also have options near industrial zones and specific project sites outside the city. When you book, we ask where you'll be working so we can suggest the right location rather than just giving you whatever's available.</p></div></div></div><div class=\"py-2\"><h2><button id=\"faqs-text-7\" type=\"button\" class=\"flex w-full items-start text-left font-semibold py-2\" aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"faqs-text-7\"><svg class=\"fill-black shrink-0 mr-4 mt-1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\"><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center rotate-90 transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect></svg><span>How do I present a serviced apartment as an option to my employer?</span></button></h2><div id=\"faqs-text-7\" role=\"region\" aria-labelledby=\"faqs-text-7\" class=\"grid text-sm ml-8 text-black overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0\"><div class=\"overflow-hidden\"><p class=\"pb-3\">The easiest way is to request a quote from our website. We can put together a proposal with apartment options, photos, and pricing that you can forward straight to your HR or procurement team. Everything is laid out so they can compare serviced apartment costs against hotels. We handle all the booking and invoicing on the company side, so there's minimal admin for anyone involved.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div><div style=\"opacity: 0; transform: none;\"><div class=\"mx-auto max-w-3xl p-4 mb-10\"><h3 class=\"mb-6 text-2xl font-bold\">For you who book for others</h3><div class=\"border-b border-black divide-y divide-black divide-white border-white\"><div class=\"py-2\"><h2><button id=\"faqs-text-0\" type=\"button\" class=\"flex w-full items-start text-left font-semibold py-2\" aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"faqs-text-0\"><svg class=\"fill-black shrink-0 mr-4 mt-1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\"><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center rotate-90 transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect></svg><span>How do I arrange serviced apartments for employees or contractors travelling to Sweden?</span></button></h2><div id=\"faqs-text-0\" role=\"region\" aria-labelledby=\"faqs-text-0\" class=\"grid text-sm ml-8 text-black overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0\"><div class=\"overflow-hidden\"><p class=\"pb-3\">Get in touch with the city, number of guests, dates, and budget, and we'll put together a proposal with apartment options, photos, and pricing. Your employees move into a fully furnished serviced apartment where everything is taken care of. Billing goes directly to your company as a consolidated invoice, and we handle key collection, welcome information, and 24/7 guest support. Whether it's one consultant or a full project team, you deal with one provider and get one invoice.</p></div></div></div><div class=\"py-2\"><h2><button id=\"faqs-text-1\" type=\"button\" class=\"flex w-full items-start text-left font-semibold py-2\" aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"faqs-text-1\"><svg class=\"fill-black shrink-0 mr-4 mt-1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\"><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center rotate-90 transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect></svg><span>Which Swedish cities do you have serviced apartments in, and how fast can you arrange one?</span></button></h2><div id=\"faqs-text-1\" role=\"region\" aria-labelledby=\"faqs-text-1\" class=\"grid text-sm ml-8 text-black overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0\"><div class=\"overflow-hidden\"><p class=\"pb-3\">We have serviced apartments in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Malmö, Helsingborg, Lund, and other locations across Sweden, covering everything from central business districts to areas near industrial sites. In most cases we can set something up the same day. For larger or more unusual needs outside our core cities, we can put together a bespoke solution. </p></div></div></div><div class=\"py-2\"><h2><button id=\"faqs-text-2\" type=\"button\" class=\"flex w-full items-start text-left font-semibold py-2\" aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"faqs-text-2\"><svg class=\"fill-black shrink-0 mr-4 mt-1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\"><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center rotate-90 transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect></svg><span>What are the booking terms for a serviced apartment — minimum stay, pricing, and cancellation?</span></button></h2><div id=\"faqs-text-2\" role=\"region\" aria-labelledby=\"faqs-text-2\" class=\"grid text-sm ml-8 text-black overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0\"><div class=\"overflow-hidden\"><p class=\"pb-3\">Minimum booking is typically five days. Pricing depends on city, apartment size, category (Basic, Standard, or Premium), and how long the stay is. The longer the booking, the lower the rate, with stays more than three months offering the best value. If a project wraps up early, you can terminate with one month's notice. We also do framework contracts for companies that need serviced apartments regularly.</p></div></div></div><div class=\"py-2\"><h2><button id=\"faqs-text-3\" type=\"button\" class=\"flex w-full items-start text-left font-semibold py-2\" aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"faqs-text-3\"><svg class=\"fill-black shrink-0 mr-4 mt-1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\"><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center rotate-90 transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect></svg><span>Can my company get a contract for ongoing serviced apartment needs?</span></button></h2><div id=\"faqs-text-3\" role=\"region\" aria-labelledby=\"faqs-text-3\" class=\"grid text-sm ml-8 text-black overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0\"><div class=\"overflow-hidden\"><p class=\"pb-3\">Absolutely. A lot of our clients are companies that need serviced apartments on an ongoing basis across different cities. A contract gets you preferred rates, a faster booking process, and a dedicated account manager. Staffing agencies, consulting firms, and companies running parallel projects in multiple cities tend to find this especially useful.</p></div></div></div><div class=\"py-2\"><h2><button id=\"faqs-text-4\" type=\"button\" class=\"flex w-full items-start text-left font-semibold py-2\" aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"faqs-text-4\"><svg class=\"fill-black shrink-0 mr-4 mt-1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\"><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center rotate-90 transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect></svg><span>How does billing and invoicing work for serviced apartments?</span></button></h2><div id=\"faqs-text-4\" role=\"region\" aria-labelledby=\"faqs-text-4\" class=\"grid text-sm ml-8 text-black overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0\"><div class=\"overflow-hidden\"><p class=\"pb-3\">We invoice your company directly. If you have people in several serviced apartments or cities, we consolidate everything into one clear invoice instead of leaving your finance team to piece together scattered hotel receipts. Pricing is agreed before the booking is confirmed, so there are no surprises.</p></div></div></div><div class=\"py-2\"><h2><button id=\"faqs-text-5\" type=\"button\" class=\"flex w-full items-start text-left font-semibold py-2\" aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"faqs-text-5\"><svg class=\"fill-black shrink-0 mr-4 mt-1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\"><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center rotate-90 transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect></svg><span>What serviced apartment categories do you offer, and how do they differ?</span></button></h2><div id=\"faqs-text-5\" role=\"region\" aria-labelledby=\"faqs-text-5\" class=\"grid text-sm ml-8 text-black overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0\"><div class=\"overflow-hidden\"><p class=\"pb-3\">There are three: Basic, Standard, and Premium. Basic is the practical choice for cost-conscious project housing. Everything you need, nothing you don't. Standard is our most booked category and works well for consultants and employees on longer assignments. It's comfortable, modern, and a genuine step up. Premium is for senior staff or situations where the serviced apartment needs to make an impression: high-end furnishings, prime locations.\n</p></div></div></div><div class=\"py-2\"><h2><button id=\"faqs-text-6\" type=\"button\" class=\"flex w-full items-start text-left font-semibold py-2\" aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"faqs-text-6\"><svg class=\"fill-black shrink-0 mr-4 mt-1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\"><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center rotate-90 transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect></svg><span>Can several employees share a serviced apartment or use it in rotation?</span></button></h2><div id=\"faqs-text-6\" role=\"region\" aria-labelledby=\"faqs-text-6\" class=\"grid text-sm ml-8 text-black overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0\"><div class=\"overflow-hidden\"><p class=\"pb-3\">Yes, and both are common. We have serviced apartments with up to five rooms for teams who want to share. We also support rotation setups where different employees use the same apartment during different periods. Between rotations we arrange cleaning and fresh linen so each person arrives to a properly prepared home.\n</p></div></div></div><div class=\"py-2\"><h2><button id=\"faqs-text-7\" type=\"button\" class=\"flex w-full items-start text-left font-semibold py-2\" aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"faqs-text-7\"><svg class=\"fill-black shrink-0 mr-4 mt-1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\"><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center rotate-90 transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect></svg><span>How does Företagsbostäder handle quality and guest satisfaction?</span></button></h2><div id=\"faqs-text-7\" role=\"region\" aria-labelledby=\"faqs-text-7\" class=\"grid text-sm ml-8 text-black overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0\"><div class=\"overflow-hidden\"><p class=\"pb-3\">Every serviced apartment is inspected before a new guest moves in, and we run regular guest surveys to stay on top of what's working and what isn't. We've been at this since 1993 and work with some of Sweden's leading companies. The partnerships that last that long don't survive on charm; they survive on consistency.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div><div style=\"opacity: 0; transform: none;\"><div class=\"mx-auto max-w-3xl p-4 mb-10\"><h3 class=\"mb-6 text-2xl font-bold\">For you who want to know more</h3><div class=\"border-b border-black divide-y divide-black divide-white border-white\"><div class=\"py-2\"><h2><button id=\"faqs-text-0\" type=\"button\" class=\"flex w-full items-start text-left font-semibold py-2\" aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"faqs-text-0\"><svg class=\"fill-black shrink-0 mr-4 mt-1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\"><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center rotate-90 transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect></svg><span>Can you handle serviced apartments for multiple employees across several Swedish cities at once?</span></button></h2><div id=\"faqs-text-0\" role=\"region\" aria-labelledby=\"faqs-text-0\" class=\"grid text-sm ml-8 text-black overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0\"><div class=\"overflow-hidden\"><p class=\"pb-3\">That's a core part of what we do. We work with large companies, staffing agencies, and relocation firms that need serviced apartments for people in different cities at the same time. You get one point of contact, consolidated billing, and dedicated account management regardless of whether it's a rotating project team, seasonal contractor staffing, or a company-wide rollout.</p></div></div></div><div class=\"py-2\"><h2><button id=\"faqs-text-1\" type=\"button\" class=\"flex w-full items-start text-left font-semibold py-2\" aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"faqs-text-1\"><svg class=\"fill-black shrink-0 mr-4 mt-1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\"><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center rotate-90 transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect></svg><span>Do you work with relocation companies and staffing agencies?</span></button></h2><div id=\"faqs-text-1\" role=\"region\" aria-labelledby=\"faqs-text-1\" class=\"grid text-sm ml-8 text-black overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0\"><div class=\"overflow-hidden\"><p class=\"pb-3\">Yes, we partner with a number of them, both in Sweden and internationally. These partnerships need us to move fast, so we're set up for multi-person bookings, staggered move-ins, and last-minute changes without a lot of back and forth.</p></div></div></div><div class=\"py-2\"><h2><button id=\"faqs-text-2\" type=\"button\" class=\"flex w-full items-start text-left font-semibold py-2\" aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"faqs-text-2\"><svg class=\"fill-black shrink-0 mr-4 mt-1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\"><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center rotate-90 transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect></svg><span>How do you support international guests who don't speak Swedish?</span></button></h2><div id=\"faqs-text-2\" role=\"region\" aria-labelledby=\"faqs-text-2\" class=\"grid text-sm ml-8 text-black overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0\"><div class=\"overflow-hidden\"><p class=\"pb-3\">All apartment information, welcome materials, and guest communication is available in English. Our team works with international guests regularly and is used to a wide range of backgrounds and needs. If your employees are arriving from abroad, we make the practical side of settling into a serviced apartment as smooth as possible.</p></div></div></div><div class=\"py-2\"><h2><button id=\"faqs-text-3\" type=\"button\" class=\"flex w-full items-start text-left font-semibold py-2\" aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"faqs-text-3\"><svg class=\"fill-black shrink-0 mr-4 mt-1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\"><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center rotate-90 transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect></svg><span>How does Företagsbostäder work with sustainability and the environment?</span></button></h2><div id=\"faqs-text-3\" role=\"region\" aria-labelledby=\"faqs-text-3\" class=\"grid text-sm ml-8 text-black overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0\"><div class=\"overflow-hidden\"><p class=\"pb-3\">We're environmentally certified according to Svensk Miljöbas (Swedish Environmental Base) and work actively on energy management, waste reduction, and sustainable transport across all our serviced apartment locations. If your company has ESG reporting requirements, we can provide documentation on our environmental commitments.</p></div></div></div><div class=\"py-2\"><h2><button id=\"faqs-text-4\" type=\"button\" class=\"flex w-full items-start text-left font-semibold py-2\" aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"faqs-text-4\"><svg class=\"fill-black shrink-0 mr-4 mt-1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\"><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center rotate-90 transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect></svg><span> Who is Företagsbostäder, and how long have you been operating?</span></button></h2><div id=\"faqs-text-4\" role=\"region\" aria-labelledby=\"faqs-text-4\" class=\"grid text-sm ml-8 text-black overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0\"><div class=\"overflow-hidden\"><p class=\"pb-3\">We started in 1993 with a handful of serviced apartments in Gothenburg. Today we're Sweden's largest provider, with thousands of serviced apartments across multiple cities. We're owned by hotel enteprise Strawberry, one of the largest hospitality groups in the Nordics. We are also part of EuRA, the European Relocation Association.\n</p></div></div></div><div class=\"py-2\"><h2><button id=\"faqs-text-5\" type=\"button\" class=\"flex w-full items-start text-left font-semibold py-2\" aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"faqs-text-5\"><svg class=\"fill-black shrink-0 mr-4 mt-1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\"><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center rotate-90 transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect></svg><span>What makes a serviced apartment different from a regular rental or an Airbnb?</span></button></h2><div id=\"faqs-text-5\" role=\"region\" aria-labelledby=\"faqs-text-5\" class=\"grid text-sm ml-8 text-black overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0\"><div class=\"overflow-hidden\"><p class=\"pb-3\">Reliability, corporate billing, and support. With a private rental or Airbnb, there's no guaranteed quality standard, no consolidated invoicing for your company, and nobody to call at 2 AM if the heating stops working. Every Företagsbostäder serviced apartment is quality-assured before move-in, your company gets invoiced directly, and your employees have round-the-clock guest support. We exist specifically for corporate stays, not holiday rentals.\n</p></div></div></div><div class=\"py-2\"><h2><button id=\"faqs-text-6\" type=\"button\" class=\"flex w-full items-start text-left font-semibold py-2\" aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"faqs-text-6\"><svg class=\"fill-black shrink-0 mr-4 mt-1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\"><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center rotate-90 transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect></svg><span>Can I see photos of the serviced apartments before booking?</span></button></h2><div id=\"faqs-text-6\" role=\"region\" aria-labelledby=\"faqs-text-6\" class=\"grid text-sm ml-8 text-black overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0\"><div class=\"overflow-hidden\"><p class=\"pb-3\">Yes. When you request a quote, the proposal we send back includes photos of the apartment type we're recommending. No stock images, you see what you're actually booking.\n</p></div></div></div><div class=\"py-2\"><h2><button id=\"faqs-text-7\" type=\"button\" class=\"flex w-full items-start text-left font-semibold py-2\" aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"faqs-text-7\"><svg class=\"fill-black shrink-0 mr-4 mt-1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\"><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect><rect y=\"7\" width=\"16\" height=\"2\" rx=\"1\" class=\"transform origin-center rotate-90 transition duration-200 ease-out \"></rect></svg><span>How do I request a quote or get started?</span></button></h2><div id=\"faqs-text-7\" role=\"region\" aria-labelledby=\"faqs-text-7\" class=\"grid text-sm ml-8 text-black overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0\"><div class=\"overflow-hidden\"><p class=\"pb-3\">Request a quote on our website, email reservations@foretagsbostader.se, or call +46 (0)10 707 55 00. Tell us the city, number of guests, dates, and any preferences on budget, location, or apartment size. We'll come back with a tailored proposal for serviced apartments that match what you need, usually within the same business employee who is looking for - Homepage\\\",\\\"translations\\\":[{\\\"id\\\":9,\\\"block_accordion_id\\\":5,\\\"languages_code\\\":\\\"en\\\",\\\"items\\\":[{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Where can I stay in Sweden for a work assignment lasting weeks or months?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"For anything beyond a few days, a serviced apartment is the most practical option. You get a proper apartment with a kitchen, living space, WiFi, and laundry access, which makes an enormous difference when you're staying for weeks rather than just passing through a city. Företagsbostäder is Sweden's largest provider of serviced apartments, with locations in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Malmö, Helsingborg, Lund, and several other cities. Your company handles the booking and billing. You just show up and move in.\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Is a serviced apartment cheaper than staying in a hotel for a long project?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Usually by a wide margin, yes. A serviced apartment gives you more space, a proper kitchen (which alone can save a fortune on food), and a daily rate that drops significantly with longer stays. For a monthly booking, the difference compared to even a mid-range hotel is hard to ignore. That's the main reason most companies have switched from hotels to serviced apartments for extended assignments.\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"What's included in a serviced apartment, so I know what to pack?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Short answer: pack like you're visiting a friend who has a fully stocked home. Every serviced apartment comes with a kitchen that has everything from a coffee maker and microwave to proper cookware and plates, plus bed linen, towels, high-speed WiFi, TV, and an iron. The rent also covers electricity and heating. Many apartments have their own washing machine; others share laundry facilities in the building. You really only need to bring your clothes and personal things.\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Can I cook my own meals and do laundry in the apartment?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Yes to both. The kitchen is fully equipped for everyday cooking. On the laundry side, some serviced apartments have a machine in the unit, and the rest have access to a shared laundry room with booking instructions in Swedish and English.\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Can I have friends, family, or colleagues over to my apartment?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Of course. That's one of the real advantages a serviced apartment has over a hotel room. Have colleagues over for dinner, let your family visit for the weekend, use the living room for an informal meeting. It's your home for the time you're there.\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"What happens if something breaks or I need help outside office hours?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"You have access to 24/7 guest service, including an emergency line for urgent things. If an appliance breaks through normal use, just report it and we'll sort out a replacement. Living in a serviced apartment should feel as supported as staying in a hotel.\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Are the serviced apartments centrally located or close to major workplaces?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"It depends on what works best for you. We have serviced apartments in city centres with easy access to public transport, and we also have options near industrial zones and specific project sites outside the city. When you book, we ask where you'll be working so we can suggest the right location rather than just giving you whatever's available.\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"How do I present a serviced apartment as an option to my employer?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"The easiest way is to request a quote from our website. We can put together a proposal with apartment options, photos, and pricing that you can forward straight to your HR or procurement team. Everything is laid out so they can compare serviced apartment costs against hotels. We handle all the booking and invoicing on the company side, so there's minimal admin for anyone involved.\\\"}],\\\"heading\\\":\\\"For you who move where the work is\\\"},{\\\"id\\\":10,\\\"block_accordion_id\\\":5,\\\"languages_code\\\":\\\"sv\\\",\\\"items\\\":[{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Var kan jag bo i Sverige under ett arbetsuppdrag som pågår i veckor eller månader?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"För allt som varar längre än några dagar är en företagslägenhet det mest praktiska alternativet. Du får en riktig lägenhet med kök, vardagsrum, WiFi och tillgång till tvättstuga — något som gör enorm skillnad när du stannar i veckor snarare än bara passerar genom en stad. Företagsbostäder är Sveriges största leverantör av företagslägenheter, med boenden i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Helsingborg, Lund och flera andra städer. Ditt företag sköter bokning och fakturering. Du flyttar helt enkelt in.\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Är en företagslägenhet billigare än att bo på hotell under ett längre projekt?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Vanligtvis med bred marginal, ja. En företagslägenhet ger dig mer yta, ett riktigt kök (som i sig kan spara en förmögenhet på mat) och ett dygnspris som sjunker rejält vid längre vistelser. Vid en månadsbokning är skillnaden jämfört med till och med ett mellanklass-hotell svår att ignorera. Det är den främsta anledningen till att de flesta företag har gått från hotell till företagslägenheter för längre uppdrag.\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Vad ingår i en företagslägenhet, så jag vet vad jag behöver packa?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Kort svar: packa som om du ska hälsa på en vän med ett fullt utrustat hem. Varje företagslägenhet har ett kök med allt från kaffebryggare och mikrovågsugn till ordentliga kokkärl och tallrikar, plus sänglinne, handdukar, snabbt WiFi, TV och strykjärn. Hyran täcker även el och värme. Många lägenheter har egen tvättmaskin, andra delar tvättstuga i byggnaden. Du behöver egentligen bara ta med kläder och personliga saker.\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Kan jag laga egen mat och tvätta i lägenheten?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Ja, båda delarna. Köket är fullt utrustat för vardagsmatlagning. På tvättsidan har vissa företagslägenheter en maskin i lägenheten, och övriga har tillgång till gemensam tvättstuga med bokningsinstruktioner på svenska och engelska.\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Kan jag ha vänner, familj eller kollegor på besök i lägenheten?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Självklart. Det är en av de verkliga fördelarna en företagslägenhet har jämfört med ett hotellrum. Ha kollegor över på middag, låt familjen komma på helgbesök, använd vardagsrummet för ett informellt möte. Det är ditt hem under tiden du bor där.\\\\n\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Vad händer om något går sönder eller jag behöver hjälp utanför kontorstid?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Du har tillgång till gästservice dygnet runt, inklusive en jourtelefon för akuta ärenden. Om en apparat går sönder genom normalt användande, rapportera det bara så ordnar vi en ersättning. Att bo i en företagslägenhet ska kännas lika tryggt som att bo på hotell.\\\\n\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Ligger företagslägenheterna centralt eller nära stora arbetsplatser?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Det beror på vad som passar dig bäst. Vi har företagslägenheter i stadskärnor med enkel tillgång till kollektivtrafik, och vi har även alternativ nära industriområden och specifika projektplatser utanför staden. Vid bokning frågar vi var du ska arbeta så att vi kan föreslå rätt läge istället för att bara ge dig det som råkar vara ledigt.\\\\n\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Hur presenterar jag en företagslägenhet som alternativ för min arbetsgivare?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Enklast är att begära en offert via vår hemsida. Vi kan sätta ihop ett förslag med lägenhetsalternativ, bilder och priser som du kan vidarebefordra direkt till HR eller inköp. Allt är upplagt så att de enkelt kan jämföra kostnaden för en företagslägenhet mot hotell. Vi sköter all bokning och fakturering på företagssidan, så det blir minimal administration för alla inblandade.\\\"}],\\\"heading\\\":\\\"För dig som flyttar dit jobbet är\\\"}]},\\\"classname\\\":\\\"divide-white border-white\\\"}]}],\\\"$L46\\\",\\\"$L47\\\"]}]}]}]\\n\"])</script><script>self.__next_f.push([1,\"35:[\\\"$\\\",\\\"rect\\\",null,{\\\"width\\\":\\\"126\\\",\\\"height\\\":\\\"70\\\",\\\"fill\\\":\\\"#928F8D\\\",\\\"mask\\\":\\\"url(#mask3)\\\"}]\\n37:[\\\"$\\\",\\\"rect\\\",null,{\\\"width\\\":\\\"126\\\",\\\"height\\\":\\\"70\\\",\\\"fill\\\":\\\"#928F8D\\\",\\\"mask\\\":\\\"url(#mask2)\\\"}]\\n39:[\\\"$\\\",\\\"rect\\\",null,{\\\"width\\\":\\\"126\\\",\\\"height\\\":\\\"70\\\",\\\"fill\\\":\\\"#928F8D\\\",\\\"mask\\\":\\\"url(#mask1)\\\"}]\\n3b:[\\\"$\\\",\\\"rect\\\",null,{\\\"width\\\":\\\"126\\\",\\\"height\\\":\\\"70\\\",\\\"fill\\\":\\\"#928F8D\\\",\\\"mask\\\":\\\"url(#mask4)\\\"}]\\n3d:[\\\"$\\\",\\\"rect\\\",null,{\\\"width\\\":\\\"126\\\",\\\"height\\\":\\\"70\\\",\\\"fill\\\":\\\"#928F8D\\\",\\\"mask\\\":\\\"url(#mask0)\\\"}]\\n3f:[\\\"$\\\",\\\"rect\\\",null,{\\\"width\\\":\\\"126\\\",\\\"height\\\":\\\"70\\\",\\\"fill\\\":\\\"#928F8D\\\",\\\"mask\\\":\\\"url(#mask6)\\\"}]\\n\"])</script><script>self.__next_f.push([1,\"46:[\\\"$\\\",\\\"$L22\\\",\\\"1\\\",{\\\"delay\\\":0.1,\\\"initial\\\":{\\\"opacity\\\":0,\\\"y\\\":20},\\\"animate\\\":{\\\"opacity\\\":1,\\\"y\\\":0},\\\"children\\\":[\\\"$\\\",\\\"$L45\\\",null,{\\\"block\\\":{\\\"id\\\":6,\\\"status\\\":\\\"published\\\",\\\"sort\\\":null,\\\"user_created\\\":\\\"29b2e211-5bae-446b-b069-1fa40cb12d4f\\\",\\\"date_created\\\":\\\"2026-03-24T13:06:33.474Z\\\",\\\"user_updated\\\":\\\"29b2e211-5bae-446b-b069-1fa40cb12d4f\\\",\\\"date_updated\\\":\\\"2026-03-26T09:36:34.878Z\\\",\\\"internal_name\\\":\\\"HR/purchasing that solves the problem - Homepage\\\",\\\"translations\\\":[{\\\"id\\\":11,\\\"block_accordion_id\\\":6,\\\"languages_code\\\":\\\"sv\\\",\\\"items\\\":[{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Hur ordnar jag företagslägenheter åt medarbetare eller konsulter som reser till Sverige?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Hör av dig med stad, antal gäster, datum och budget, så sätter vi ihop ett förslag med lägenhetsalternativ, bilder och priser. Era medarbetare flyttar in i en fullt möblerad företagslägenhet där allt är ordnat. Faktureringen går direkt till ert företag som en samlad faktura, och vi sköter nyckelutlämning, välkomstinformation och gästsupport dygnet runt. Oavsett om det gäller en konsult eller ett helt projektteam har ni en leverantör och får en faktura.\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Vilka svenska städer har ni företagslägenheter i, och hur snabbt kan ni ordna en?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Vi har företagslägenheter i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Helsingborg, Lund och andra orter runt om i Sverige — allt från centrala affärsdistrikt till områden nära industrianläggningar. I de flesta fall kan vi ordna något samma dag. För större eller mer ovanliga behov utanför våra kärnstäder kan vi ta fram en skräddarsydd lösning.\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Vilka bokningsvillkor gäller för en företagslägenhet — minsta vistelsetid, prissättning och avbokning?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Minsta bokning är normalt fem dagar. Priset beror på stad, lägenhetsstorlek, kategori (Basic, Standard eller Premium) och vistelsens längd. Ju längre bokning, desto lägre pris — vistelser över tre månader ger bäst värde. Om ett projekt avslutas i förtid kan ni säga upp med en månads uppsägningstid. Vi erbjuder även ramavtal för företag som behöver företagslägenheter regelbundet.\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Kan mitt företag teckna avtal för löpande behov av företagslägenheter?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Absolut. Många av våra kunder är företag som behöver företagslägenheter löpande i olika städer. Ett avtal ger er förmånliga priser, snabbare bokningsprocess och en dedikerad kontaktperson. Bemanningsföretag, konsultfirmor och företag som driver parallella projekt i flera städer brukar ha särskilt stor nytta av detta.\\\\n\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Hur fungerar fakturering för företagslägenheter?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Vi fakturerar ert företag direkt. Om ni har personer i flera företagslägenheter eller städer samlar vi allt på en tydlig faktura istället för att er ekonomiavdelning ska pussla ihop utspridda hotellkvitton. Priset avtalas innan bokningen bekräftas, så det kommer inga överraskningar.\\\\n\\\\n\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Vilka kategorier av företagslägenheter erbjuder ni, och hur skiljer de sig åt?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Det finns tre: Basic, Standard och Premium. Basic är det praktiska valet för kostnadsmedveten projektboende. Allt du behöver, inget du inte behöver. Standard är vår mest bokade kategori och fungerar bra för konsulter och medarbetare på längre uppdrag. Den är bekväm, modern och ett genuint steg upp. Premium är för seniora medarbetare eller situationer där företagslägenheten behöver göra intryck: exklusiv inredning, förstklassiga lägen.\\\\n\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Kan flera medarbetare dela en företagslägenhet eller använda den i rotation?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Ja, och båda varianterna är vanliga. Vi har företagslägenheter med upp till fem rum för team som vill dela. Vi stödjer även rotationsupplägg där olika medarbetare använder samma lägenhet under olika perioder. Mellan rotationerna ordnar vi städning och fräscha lakan så att varje person anländer till ett ordentligt förberett hem.\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Hur arbetar Företagsbostäder med kvalitet och gästnöjdhet?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Varje företagslägenhet inspekteras innan en ny gäst flyttar in, och vi genomför regelbundna gästundersökningar för att ha koll på vad som fungerar och vad som kan bli bättre. Vi har gjort det här sedan 1993 och samarbetar med flera av Sveriges ledande företag. Partnerskap som varar så länge överlever inte på charm — de överlever på konsekvens.\\\"}],\\\"heading\\\":\\\"För dig som bokar åt andra \\\"},{\\\"id\\\":12,\\\"block_accordion_id\\\":6,\\\"languages_code\\\":\\\"en\\\",\\\"items\\\":[{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"How do I arrange serviced apartments for employees or contractors travelling to Sweden?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Get in touch with the city, number of guests, dates, and budget, and we'll put together a proposal with apartment options, photos, and pricing. Your employees move into a fully furnished serviced apartment where everything is taken care of. Billing goes directly to your company as a consolidated invoice, and we handle key collection, welcome information, and 24/7 guest support. Whether it's one consultant or a full project team, you deal with one provider and get one invoice.\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Which Swedish cities do you have serviced apartments in, and how fast can you arrange one?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"We have serviced apartments in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Malmö, Helsingborg, Lund, and other locations across Sweden, covering everything from central business districts to areas near industrial sites. In most cases we can set something up the same day. For larger or more unusual needs outside our core cities, we can put together a bespoke solution. \\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"What are the booking terms for a serviced apartment — minimum stay, pricing, and cancellation?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Minimum booking is typically five days. Pricing depends on city, apartment size, category (Basic, Standard, or Premium), and how long the stay is. The longer the booking, the lower the rate, with stays more than three months offering the best value. If a project wraps up early, you can terminate with one month's notice. We also do framework contracts for companies that need serviced apartments regularly.\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Can my company get a contract for ongoing serviced apartment needs?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Absolutely. A lot of our clients are companies that need serviced apartments on an ongoing basis across different cities. A contract gets you preferred rates, a faster booking process, and a dedicated account manager. Staffing agencies, consulting firms, and companies running parallel projects in multiple cities tend to find this especially useful.\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"How does billing and invoicing work for serviced apartments?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"We invoice your company directly. If you have people in several serviced apartments or cities, we consolidate everything into one clear invoice instead of leaving your finance team to piece together scattered hotel receipts. Pricing is agreed before the booking is confirmed, so there are no surprises.\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"What serviced apartment categories do you offer, and how do they differ?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"There are three: Basic, Standard, and Premium. Basic is the practical choice for cost-conscious project housing. Everything you need, nothing you don't. Standard is our most booked category and works well for consultants and employees on longer assignments. It's comfortable, modern, and a genuine step up. Premium is for senior staff or situations where the serviced apartment needs to make an impression: high-end furnishings, prime locations.\\\\n\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Can several employees share a serviced apartment or use it in rotation?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Yes, and both are common. We have serviced apartments with up to five rooms for teams who want to share. We also support rotation setups where different employees use the same apartment during different periods. Between rotations we arrange cleaning and fresh linen so each person arrives to a properly prepared home.\\\\n\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"How does Företagsbostäder handle quality and guest satisfaction?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Every serviced apartment is inspected before a new guest moves in, and we run regular guest surveys to stay on top of what's working and what isn't. We've been at this since 1993 and work with some of Sweden's leading companies. The partnerships that last that long don't survive on charm; they survive on consistency.\\\"}],\\\"heading\\\":\\\"For you who book for others\\\"}]},\\\"classname\\\":\\\"divide-white border-white\\\"}]}]\\n\"])</script><script>self.__next_f.push([1,\"47:[\\\"$\\\",\\\"$L22\\\",\\\"2\\\",{\\\"delay\\\":0.2,\\\"initial\\\":{\\\"opacity\\\":0,\\\"y\\\":20},\\\"animate\\\":{\\\"opacity\\\":1,\\\"y\\\":0},\\\"children\\\":[\\\"$\\\",\\\"$L45\\\",null,{\\\"block\\\":{\\\"id\\\":7,\\\"status\\\":\\\"published\\\",\\\"sort\\\":null,\\\"user_created\\\":\\\"29b2e211-5bae-446b-b069-1fa40cb12d4f\\\",\\\"date_created\\\":\\\"2026-03-24T13:09:45.602Z\\\",\\\"user_updated\\\":\\\"29b2e211-5bae-446b-b069-1fa40cb12d4f\\\",\\\"date_updated\\\":\\\"2026-03-26T09:36:34.897Z\\\",\\\"internal_name\\\":\\\"Scale, trust and next steps - Homepage\\\",\\\"translations\\\":[{\\\"id\\\":13,\\\"block_accordion_id\\\":7,\\\"languages_code\\\":\\\"en\\\",\\\"items\\\":[{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Can you handle serviced apartments for multiple employees across several Swedish cities at once?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"That's a core part of what we do. We work with large companies, staffing agencies, and relocation firms that need serviced apartments for people in different cities at the same time. You get one point of contact, consolidated billing, and dedicated account management regardless of whether it's a rotating project team, seasonal contractor staffing, or a company-wide rollout.\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Do you work with relocation companies and staffing agencies?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Yes, we partner with a number of them, both in Sweden and internationally. These partnerships need us to move fast, so we're set up for multi-person bookings, staggered move-ins, and last-minute changes without a lot of back and forth.\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"How do you support international guests who don't speak Swedish?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"All apartment information, welcome materials, and guest communication is available in English. Our team works with international guests regularly and is used to a wide range of backgrounds and needs. If your employees are arriving from abroad, we make the practical side of settling into a serviced apartment as smooth as possible.\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"How does Företagsbostäder work with sustainability and the environment?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"We're environmentally certified according to Svensk Miljöbas (Swedish Environmental Base) and work actively on energy management, waste reduction, and sustainable transport across all our serviced apartment locations. If your company has ESG reporting requirements, we can provide documentation on our environmental commitments.\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\" Who is Företagsbostäder, and how long have you been operating?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"We started in 1993 with a handful of serviced apartments in Gothenburg. Today we're Sweden's largest provider, with thousands of serviced apartments across multiple cities. We're owned by hotel enteprise Strawberry, one of the largest hospitality groups in the Nordics. We are also part of EuRA, the European Relocation Association.\\\\n\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"What makes a serviced apartment different from a regular rental or an Airbnb?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Reliability, corporate billing, and support. With a private rental or Airbnb, there's no guaranteed quality standard, no consolidated invoicing for your company, and nobody to call at 2 AM if the heating stops working. Every Företagsbostäder serviced apartment is quality-assured before move-in, your company gets invoiced directly, and your employees have round-the-clock guest support. We exist specifically for corporate stays, not holiday rentals.\\\\n\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Can I see photos of the serviced apartments before booking?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Yes. When you request a quote, the proposal we send back includes photos of the apartment type we're recommending. No stock images, you see what you're actually booking.\\\\n\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"How do I request a quote or get started?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Request a quote on our website, email reservations@foretagsbostader.se, or call +46 (0)10 707 55 00. Tell us the city, number of guests, dates, and any preferences on budget, location, or apartment size. We'll come back with a tailored proposal for serviced apartments that match what you need, usually within the same business day.\\\\n\\\"}],\\\"heading\\\":\\\"For you who want to know more\\\"},{\\\"id\\\":14,\\\"block_accordion_id\\\":7,\\\"languages_code\\\":\\\"sv\\\",\\\"items\\\":[{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Kan ni hantera företagslägenheter för flera medarbetare i olika svenska städer samtidigt?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Det är en central del av vad vi gör. Vi samarbetar med stora företag, bemanningsföretag och relocation-firmor som behöver företagslägenheter för personer i olika städer samtidigt. Ni får en kontaktperson, samlad fakturering och dedikerad kundansvar oavsett om det rör sig om ett roterande projektteam, säsongsbetonad konsultbemanning eller en företagsövergripande utrullning.\\\\n\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Samarbetar ni med relocation-företag och bemanningsföretag?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Ja, vi samarbetar med ett flertal, både i Sverige och internationellt. Dessa partnerskap kräver att vi agerar snabbt, så vi är rustade för flerboendebokningar, stegvisa inflyttningar och ändringar i sista minuten utan en massa onödig dialog.\\\\n\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Hur stödjer ni internationella gäster som inte talar svenska?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"All lägenhetsinformation, välkomstmaterial och gästkommunikation finns tillgänglig på engelska. Vårt team arbetar regelbundet med internationella gäster och är vant vid en mängd olika bakgrunder och behov. Om era medarbetare kommer från utlandet gör vi den praktiska sidan av att flytta in i en företagslägenhet så smidig som möjligt.\\\\n\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Hur arbetar Företagsbostäder med hållbarhet och miljö?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Vi är miljöcertifierade enligt Svensk Miljöbas och arbetar aktivt med energihantering, avfallsminimering och hållbara transporter på samtliga våra företagslägenhetsorter. Om ert företag har krav på ESG-rapportering kan vi tillhandahålla dokumentation om våra miljöåtaganden.\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Vilka är Företagsbostäder och hur länge har ni funnits?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Vi startade 1993 med en handfull företagslägenheter i Göteborg. Idag är vi Sveriges största leverantör, med tusentals företagslägenheter i flera städer. Vi ägs av hotellkoncernen Strawberry, en av Nordens största aktörer inom hospitality. Vi är även en del av EuRA, European Relocation Association.\\\\n\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Vad skiljer en företagslägenhet från en vanlig hyresrätt eller en Airbnb?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Pålitlighet, företagsfakturering och support. Med en privat uthyrning eller Airbnb finns det ingen garanterad kvalitetsstandard, ingen samlad fakturering för ert företag och ingen att ringa klockan två på natten om värmen slutar fungera. Varje företagslägenhet från Företagsbostäder är kvalitetssäkrad före inflyttning, ert företag faktureras direkt och era medarbetare har gästsupport dygnet runt. Vi finns till specifikt för företagsboenden, inte semesteruthyrning.\\\\n\\\\n\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Kan jag se bilder på företagslägenheterna innan jag bokar?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Ja. När du begär en offert skickar vi tillbaka ett förslag med bilder på den lägenhetstyp vi rekommenderar. Inga stockbilder — du ser vad du faktiskt bokar.\\\\n\\\"},{\\\"heading\\\":\\\"Hur begär jag en offert eller kommer igång?\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"Begär en offert på vår hemsida, mejla reservations@foretagsbostader.se eller ring +46 (0)10 707 55 00. Berätta vilken stad, antal gäster, datum och eventuella önskemål kring budget, läge eller lägenhetsstorlek. Vi återkommer med ett skräddarsytt förslag på företagslägenheter som matchar era behov — vanligtvis inom samma arbetsdag.\\\\n\\\"}],\\\"heading\\\":\\\"För dig som vill veta mer\\\"}]},\\\"classname\\\":\\\"divide-white border-white\\\"}]}]\\n\"])</script><script id=\"_next-gtm-init\" data-nscript=\"afterInteractive\">\n      (function(w,l){\n        w[l]=w[l]||[];\n
